## Fields

### Machine {#machine}

`Machine = 1`

Written to this editor and this account - the Library, EditorPrefs, the home directory -
and never committed. Every machine that opens the project runs these for itself, and they
are what a fresh clone is missing.

### Project {#project}

`Project = 0`

Written into the project - Assets, ProjectSettings, Packages, files at its root - and
committed with it. Runs once per project; a clone already has it.
